metadata.name: Nationalist Conservatism
metadata.description: The national-conservative school articulated in the Edmund Burke Foundation statement of 2022; not ethnic supremacism, all nationalisms, or every policy of its signatories.
metadata.scope: The national-conservative school articulated in the Edmund Burke Foundation statement of 2022; not ethnic supremacism, all nationalisms, or every policy of its signatories. Revision2 is an incomplete evidence audit of this specified school. Unsupported modern applications and empirical causal comparisons are null/unknown. Neither agreement nor neutrality is inferred from silence. Historical or programme sources are not a complete contemporary incumbent-government record.
metadata.phrase: A society organised around an independent nation, shared traditions, family institutions and a public role for its religious heritage.

axes.brief: The 2022 declaration endorses constitutional restraints and representative legislatures while criticising judicial policy-making.
